Big Sky Veterans Behavioral Clinic REFERRAL LETTER 06/20/2083 To: Dr. Anders Kowalczyk, Missoula Oral Surgery Group, fax (406) 555-0127 Re: PAGE, DESMOND DOB 09/12/2021 MRN VBH-7-318402 Member ID SSP-0058-4471-7
Dear Dr. Kowalczyk,
Please see Mr. Page (Desmond; goes by Dez), a 61 year old veteran, for evaluation of multiple missing teeth and a prior tooth infection (lost teeth June 2081). He has gum disease (gingivitis x 2), borderline BP and prediabetes. I'm sending him to you because he can't chew well and has lost weight (82 kg now).
He's very nervous about dental work, and has hx of PTSD-like symptoms related to his service, so please be gentle. His wife Lark usually comes along and is a great advocate. His pager is not on (autocorrect made it "pagan"). Best number (406) 555-0113 ext 4417.
Please turn the page for his medications. (page 2 of 2) Meds: HCTZ 25 mg was a one-time dispense 5/8/2078; naproxen 2081. Allergies none.
Sincerely, Sunita Vazhappilly, MD S.V. dictated, not read (transcriptionist: "Vazhapily" -- the correct is Vazhappilly)
